headline: 1,561,800 numbered canaries written through rsyslog and journald on an Ubuntu 24.04 host and counted again in Elasticsearch across 25 conditions: default pipelines lost up to 84.8% (Fluent Bit, Elasticsearch stopped for 10 min), and 82 of 124 lossy streams left no log line anywhere saying events were lost.
